Centre Denies Denying Entry to Films at Kerala Festival

The Union government has denied claims of censorship and refusing entry to films at the IDSFFK (International Documentary and Short Film Festival of Kerala). Minister Shashi Tharoor had alleged censorship, but the Centre stated that no films were denied entry. However, reports indicate that 31 films were not cleared for the festival, with the Centre reportedly not providing a reason for this decision.
